title: Pessoa Analista De Suporte N1
description:

Facilidade para interação com diferentes áreas internas.DIFERENCIAL: Experiência em triagem ou gestão de chamados de suporte. Experiência em ambientes de tecnologia ou software de produtos financeiros. Vivência com acompanhamento e controle de demandas em ferramentas de suporte. Desejável: Formação em TI ou ADM Conhecimentos básicos de SQL/ consultas a banco de dados. Chamada de serviços (webservices) Experiência administrativa em gestão de chamados e ou/ atendimento ao suporte N1. Sistema: Gestão de Garantias, Java, banco de dados Oracle.O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ ️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível) Assistência Médica Assistência Odontológica Einstein Conecta: Orientação médica online com os especialistas do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito. ️ Seguro de Vida: Segurança para você e quem você ama. Auxílio Creche: Para ajudar nas despesas dos pequenos Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida: Mais tempo para aproveitar os momentos especiais. Previdência Privada: Planeje o futuro com segurança. Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR): Sucesso compartilhado com todos. Gympass: Acesso a academias e atividades físicas para manter a saúde em dia. Reset Day: 1 dia OFF por ano para aproveitar da melhor forma. Plano Petlove: um cuidado especial para os companheiros de home office Plataforma Onhappy: Benefícios e facilidades para suas viagens e momentos de lazerPor que escolher a Dimensa?Na Dimensa, você fará parte de um time que está revolucionando o mercado de operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros, com inovação e tecnologia de ponta. Queremos conhecer você e ver como você pode contribuir para nossa missão!Junte-se a nós e faça a diferença.#VEMFAZERPARTEDAONDAVERDE

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:

Start Date:Ongoing Screener Criteria:Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.) Eligible Locations: Language Requirement:Fluent English Type of contract:Freelance / On-Call Advisory Hourly Rate:$60.00 Minimum Hours:No minimum Maximum Hours:Ad hoc / Subject to project availabilityAbout Prolific Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world. Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.The Opportunity We are invitingCertified Accountantsto join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role;
instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis forB2B and AI Researchprojects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic. Please note:This is a\ "bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.What you'll be doing When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve: Professional document analysis:Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity. Domain-specific validation:Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards. Business logic synthesis:Providing the professional\ "human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.What you'll bring Active certification:You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.G.,CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA,or regional equivalent). Technical rigor:The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions. Global perspective:We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets. Integrity:All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.Why join this project? This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At$60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again;
simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.Links to more information on Prolific Website YoutubePrivacy Statement By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Professor De Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor De Espanhol em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .Necessário:Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Clinical Study Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia's headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a 'can-do' attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

Product ownership and ability to work in an agile environment and create user stories;
Excellent communicationskills;
Strong project management skills.What's next: It's best to apply today, because job postings can be taken down and we wouldn't want you to miss this opportunity. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties and responsibilities required of employees assigned to this job.Diversity & Inclusion Here at the Stefanini Group, we value plurality and equity, regardless of race, sexual orientation, disability, age, ancestry, religion, gender, and nationality. title: Senior Backend (Node.Js) Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend (Node.Js) Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that's at the forefront of AI innovation.

About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll be designing and architecting scalable solutions, creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn't just another engineering role. We're solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we're building isn't just an upgrade – it's a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .

What You'll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO's platform.
  • You'll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.Js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.Js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.G., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).

What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.

Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that's at the forefront of AI innovation.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll be designing and architecting scalable solutions, creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn't just another engineering role. We're solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we're building isn't just an upgrade – it's a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .

  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile

  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.Js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.Js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.G., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.

Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Development Orchestrator em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Location:Remote Type:Full-Time Reports to:CEO Stack:TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:ImmediateThe Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;
the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;
the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;
the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;
quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Development Orchestrator em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Location:Remote Type:Full-Time Reports to:CEO Stack:TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:ImmediateThe Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;
the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;
the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;
the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;
quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

ponta com poucos direcionamentos Experiência com ferramentas de Gestão de Projetos como JIRA e Confluence Experiência com metodologias ágeis como Scrum ou Kanban Capacidade de gerir e disseminar conhecimento técnico com analistas de menor senioridade.Você pode se destacar se tiver: Experiência com Python ou R para análises mais avançadas (segmentação, modelos preditivos, análise estatística) One, Salesforce) Processos de implementação ou migração de ferramentas de analytics (ex: UA → GA4) Migração de dados entre Data Warehouses (Big Query → AWS) Conceitos de privacidade de dados e suas implicações na coleta (LGPD, consentimento, server-side tracking) Plataformas de cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)Curtiu a oportunidade? Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today's competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.About the Role As aBusiness Development Representative (BDR), you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. You'll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.About You We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales. English Proficiency– Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives. Experience with Sales Solutions(Preferred)– Prior experience engaging HR and Finance executives is a strong plus. Curious & Coachable– Eager to learn and grow;
open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training. Self-Starter– Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members. Tech-Savvy– Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms. Comfortable in afast-paced, evolving environment .Key Responsibilities Lead Generation Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts. Cold call and email Director and above level executives to secure meetings and demos. Team Coordination Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs. Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team's success. Data Management Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs. Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date. Metrics & KPIs Number of dials per day (150+ average) and meeting conversion rate. Number of meaningful conversations and meetings booked. Email outreach volume and reply rate. Meeting attendance rate. Schedule Full-time, 40 hours/week. Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET. Open to applicants based in LATAM. What We Offer Competitive base salary + commission (60/40 split). SPIFFs and performance incentives. Training, mentoring, and growth opportunities to become a top-performing sales professional.P.S. If you cold call me at -eight-eight on WhatsApp or reach out on LinkedIn, you'll jump to the front of the line.

Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;
the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;
quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

description:

Revel Street LLC helps corporate event planners discover and reach private dining venues through an extensive, dependable database. We use LLMs extensively to gather and enrich venue data, streamline the event planning workflow, and reduce the time and effort required to source options for events such as private dining, cocktail receptions, and conferences. title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and DevOps processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (IaC).Primary Job Duties: Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time. Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work. Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues. Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision. Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design. Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures. Support DevOps practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues. Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices. Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings. Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis. Improve system reliability through automation and observability.Qualifications Required Qualifications:The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role. Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration. Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS. Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows. Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools. Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.G., Git). Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar. Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly. Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required. Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing.Desired Qualifications:The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role. Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.G., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity. AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or Developer. Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems. Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly. Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position.This role starts at R$10,000 per month

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Evaluation Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About FirstIgnite FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack. We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.The Role We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse. This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.What You'll Do Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents. Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\ "does this surface the right principal investigator?\ ") into precise, measurable rubrics. Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests. Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch. Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion. Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.Requirements 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling. Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them. Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked. Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week. Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.Preferred Qualifications Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents. Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems. Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain. Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.Why This Role You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define. AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue. Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring. Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.As part of your LinkedIn application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you're proud of.Please email the video towith the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

title: Redator
description:

Procurando alguém para criar um site sobre séries!Estou desenvolvendo a ideia de um site totalmente dedicado a séries — com críticas, recomendações, notícias, listas temáticas e análises de episódios.Busco alguém interessado em participar da criação do projeto, seja na parte de desenvolvimento, design ou conteúdo. A ideia é construir algo moderno, organizado e com potencial de crescimento.Se você curte séries e tem interesse em fazer parte desse projeto (como parceria ou trabalho remunerado, a combinar), me chama no direct para conversarmos melhor!Vamos criar algo incrível juntos?Descrição da Empresa Clube Séries é uma comunidade apaixonada pelo universo dos seriados, dedicada a trazer informações atuais e relevantes sobre o mundo do entretenimento. Atuamos como uma plataforma colaborativa, conectando fãs de séries e criando conteúdo de alta qualidade para artigos, notícias e resenhas. Nosso objetivo é informar e entreter nosso público, promovendo discussões e reflexões sobre as novidades e tendências da televisão e do streaming. Nossa equipe valoriza a criatividade, a dedicação e a paixão pela escrita. Descrição do Cargo O Redator de Notícias será responsável por escrever e publicar artigos informativos sobre o universo das séries, incluindo análises, comentários e comunicados de imprensa. As atividades diárias incluem pesquisa de temas relevantes, redação e revisão de textos e colaboração com outros membros da equipe para garantir o alinhamento com os objetivos editoriais. Este é um cargo voluntário com flexibilidade para trabalho remoto. Qualificações Redação de Notícias e Releases: Experiência em escrever notícias e comunicados de imprensa com clareza, concisão e precisão. Habilidades de Comunicação: Capacidade de transmitir informações de forma eficaz por meio da escrita e colaborar com a equipe de forma clara e produtiva. Jornalismo e Escrita: Conhecimento e prática em técnicas de jornalismo e habilidade para produzir conteúdo de qualidade que capte a atenção dos leitores. Será um diferencial ter conhecimento em tendências de entretenimento e séries de TV, bem como habilidades em SEO para otimizar o alcance do conteúdo online.Descrição da EmpresaClube Séries é uma plataforma dedicada aos apaixonados por séries de TV, trazendo conteúdos relevantes e diversificados sobre o universo dos seriados. Nosso objetivo é conectar fãs e compartilhar as últimas novidades por meio de resenhas, análises e notícias exclusivas. Com uma equipe dinâmica e apaixonada, buscamos inspirar e engajar nossa audiência no Brasil e além. Descrição do CargoEstamos à procura de uma pessoa criativa e comprometida para atuar como redator, editor e social mídia em nosso time. As principais responsabilidades incluem criação e edição de conteúdos, gestão das redes sociais, planejamento de publicações e interação com a comunidade de seguidores. Esta é uma oportunidade de ser voluntário e ganhar experiência no setor, com a vantagem de trabalhar remotamente. Qualificações Produção e Edição de Conteúdo:Experiência ou interesse em produzir e editar textos envolventes para artigos, resenhas e conteúdos relacionados a séries e entretenimento. Gestão de Redes Sociais:Conhecimento sobre plataformas sociais, como Instagram, Twitter e Facebook. Habilidade em planejar publicações, interagir com seguidores e monitorar engajamento. Comunicação:Capacidade de escrita criativa e clara, acompanhada de habilidade para adaptar o tom de voz de acordo com a audiência. É desejável que a pessoa tenha familiaridade com ferramentas de design para criar conteúdos visuais, além de estar atualizada com tendências no universo de séries e mídias digitais.

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Evaluation Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About FirstIgnite FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack. We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.The Role We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse. This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.What You'll Do Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents. Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\ "does this surface the right principal investigator?\ ") into precise, measurable rubrics. Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests. Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch. Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion. Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.Requirements 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling. Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them. Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked. Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week. Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.Preferred Qualifications Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents. Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems. Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain. Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.Why This Role You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define. AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue. Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring. Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.As part of your LinkedIn application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you're proud of.Please email the video towith the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

title: Data Annotator
description:

Who is Blueprint Technologies? We are a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States and an expanding footprint across Latin America (LATAM). It is an evaluation and analysis role requiring strong judgment and attention to detail.Language Requirement Fluency inEnglish + at least oneof the following languages: Chinese (Simplified and/or Traditional) Japanese Korean Italian German FrenchWhat You'll Work On You will evaluate AI responses across scenarios such as: General-purpose Q&A Web search results File-based and image-based responses Image and file generation tasks Single-turn and multi-turn conversationsResponsibilities Perform side-by-side (SBS) comparisons of AI-generated responses Evaluate outputs based on: Accuracy Relevance Clarity Instruction-following Identify nuances in tone, meaning, and cultural context across languages Apply detailed, scenario-specific annotation guidelines Maintain consistency and high-quality evaluationsRequired Qualifications Professional fluency inEnglish + at least one target language listed above Prior experience withside-by-side (SBS) labeling or annotation Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail Ability to quickly understand and apply structured evaluation frameworksPreferred Qualifications Background in linguistics, translation, or localization Experience in: AI evaluation Data annotation Search relevance or content quality analysisCompensation We offer competitive compensation aligned with local markets and experience. Estimated hourly range: R$75 – R$85 BRL Estimated monthly equivalent (full-time): R$12,000 – R$13,600 BRL Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity.Training & Qualification All new hires will complete a structured onboarding program, including: Training sessions and practice exercises Calibration against quality benchmarks Qualification review before moving into production workBenefits & Employment Structure This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EOR) partner, ensuring full compliance with local labor laws and payroll requirements. Employees receive locally compliant benefits, which may include: Statutory benefits (e.G., paid leave, 13th salary where applicable) Social security and healthcare contributions Additional benefits aligned with local market practicesWhy Blueprint? Work on cutting-edge AI systems Be part of a global, multilingual team Build highly transferable AI evaluation skills Contribute directly to improving real-world AI experiencesEqual Opportunity Employer Blueprint Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, or any other protected status.

description:

Esta função é estratégica para nossas soluções de marketing orientadas a dados. Buscamos alguém que combine domínio técnico em engenharia de dados com afinidade real por inteligência artificial, experiência prática com Databricks e conhecimento em plataformas de CRM.Principais AtribuiçõesDesenvolve e mantém pipelines de dados em Databricks, usando PySpark e Delta Lake para ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados em escala. Constrói e sustenta fluxos ETL/ELT robustos, com foco em qualidade, rastreabilidade e performance. Integra dados de plataformas de CRM (como Salesforce) aos pipelines de dados, garantindo consistência e confiabilidade das informações de clientes. Aplica conceitos de IA e Machine Learning no contexto de dados de marketing, colaborando com times de ciência de dados na preparação e feature engineering de datasets. Escreve SQL e código Python com qualidade de produção, incluindo testes unitários e revisão técnica. Contribui para arquiteturas de Data Lakehouse, incluindo organização de camadas (Bronze/Silver/Gold) e governança de dados. Participa de revisões de projeto e código, propondo melhorias técnicas com consistência.Requisitos e QualificaçõesExperiência sólida com Databricks (notebooks, clusters, Jobs, Unity Catalog). Domínio de SQL e Python para manipulação e transformação de dados. Conhecimento em PySpark e Delta Lake. Experiência com ferramentas e conceitos de ETL/ELT. Conhecimento sólido em CRM, com experiência prática em plataformas como Salesforce (integração via API, estrutura de objetos, sincronização de dados). Familiaridade com práticas de MLOps ou integração de modelos de IA em pipelines de dados. Entendimento de infraestrutura de dados: armazenamento em nuvem, orquestração de jobs e controle de versão. Afinidade com metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil e boas práticas de engenharia de software.DiferencialExperiência com plataformas de nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) integradas ao Databricks. Conhecimento em LLMs, embeddings ou pipelines de dados para aplicações generativas. Vivência com Marketing Cloud ou outras ferramentas de automação de marketing integradas ao Salesforce.O que você vai encontrar por aqui: Plano de saúde e Odontológico Sulamérica extensivo a dependentes Seguro de vida VR ou VA Auxílio home office Auxílio Creche (para filhos até 5 anos e 11 meses);

Sobre a dentsu internacional Parte da dentsu, dentsu internacional com sede em Londres, opera em mais de 145 mercados no mundo inteiro com mais de 48.000 colaboradores. Ajudamos nossos clientes a conquistar, manter e fazer crescer seus consumidores e alcançar um progresso significativo para os seus negócios. Com os melhores serviços e soluções em mídia, CXM, e criatividade.Trabalhando conosco Juntando-se à dentsu international, você se juntará a um grupo de 48.000 pessoas. Será uma oportunidade de produzir trabalho orientado para a construção da sua carreira. Ao longo do caminho, você se unirá a colegas inspiradores e encontrará uma riqueza de clientes, culturas e experiências. Oferecemos desafios motivadores, experiências memoráveis e oportunidades para moldar seu futuro.Inclusão e Diversidade Estamos orgulhosos de ser diferente e isso começa com nossa gente. Acreditamos na igualdade de oportunidades para todos e não definimos as pessoas por sua raça, sexo, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência. A individualidade é o que nos torna grandes, queremos que cada um traga seu eu completo para o trabalho e crie algo surpreendente. É com isso que nos preocupamos. Portanto, quer você se junte a nós, quer procure mudar para uma parte diferente do negócio, nós trabalhamos duro para garantir a criação de oportunidades iguais para todos.Nossas 8 maneirasCom mais de 48.000 especialistas dedicados em 145 mercados, nossas '8 maneiras' formam e guiam a maneira como fazemos as coisas aqui, de modo que, juntos, podemos alcançar o 'nunca antes' para nossos clientes, para a sociedade e uns para os outros.Nós sonhamos alto. Inspiramos mudanças. Formamos equipes sem limites. Todos nós lideramos. Tornamos isso realidade. Escalamos alto. Escolhemos a emoção. Somos uma força para o bem. Somos dentsuMantenha-se conectadoVisite nosso website para saber mais e se conectar conosco nas mídias sociais.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we're not just building products, we're pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.Innovate with Tether Tether Finance:Our innovative product suite features the world's most trusted stablecoin,USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that's just the beginning: Tether Power:Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data:Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions likeKEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you're passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We've grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future?About the job As a senior Frontend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the frontend components of multiple applications related to the platform. This includes: New Products and Features- Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry. Performance- all ui components that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth. Security- Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Frontend Development team is responsible for building all the interactions with API services with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.Responsibilities Collaborate with the team to work on the development of the Bitfinex KYC webapps. Including: New Features: Create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional KYC experience for customers and compliance officers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies. Scalability: The web application must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth. Design: Build beautiful reactive applications and trading tools. Domain knowledge: willing to learn the domain-related logic and condition-based logic, including the one based on difference between multiple users scenarios and combinations of factors Debugging: Being able to debug hidden/hard to find issues when needed, advanced usage of browser debugging tools, including network, source, stop points etc.Requirements With 5+ years of proven experience in software development, with a strong focus on Frontend. Knowledgeable and experienced with micro-service architecture. Comfortable with high-availability concepts. Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+. Thoroughly experienced with React, SASS, Redux, build tools and the core principles surrounding these. Some backend experience to be able to run the app locally via NodeJS, with MongoDB, configuring ports and local environment Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools. Experienced with RESTful and RPC-based APIs. Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life. Interest in modernising and optimising different web applications.Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels.We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:  Verify the recruiter's identity.All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you're unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods.We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses.All communication from us will come from emails ending in@ tether.Toor @ tether.Io We will never request payment or financial details.If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
